why: BLOCKED_FIRE_CUES lives in presentation/blocked-fire.ts (issue #473) so the audio director and the ring do not import the flag parser to name a cue. Dropping `ring-audio` from the SET while the TYPE union keeps it is the failure a stale copy would produce: each consumer's one-row-per-cue table still enumerates every union member and the set now names one fewer, so the key comparison fails in every consumer at once. Re-anchored for issue #516's matrix, which grew the set from 5 to 17 and moved the paired arms to the end of the list; the set is 16 now that issues #526 and #536 have retired `turret` and `smoke`, but the paired arms are still last, so the anchor holds.
